blocks.text: The principal reader-facing synthesis is [derived_main_results.md](tables/derived_main_results.md), with a rendered companion at [derived_main_results.png](tables/derived_main_results.png). It reports the clean-versus-outdated admission comparisons, receiver-model robustness, visible-contradiction boundary, selective revalidation, continuity result, and measured token, latency, and cost overhead. Values are derived from the machine-readable summaries and canonical reports listed below; the table is not a new experiment.

The primary machine summaries in this ARA are `cross-model-formal-summary-20260812.json`, `cross-model-kimi-summary-20260812.json`, `cross-model-qwen-summary-20260812.json`, `knowledge-handoff-early-results-20260812.json`, and `results-matrix-cross-model-formal-20260812.json`. The complete local experiment inventory and invalid/superseded paths remain in `../../docs/LOCAL_EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md`; the interpretation matrix is `../../docs/RESULTS_MATRIX.md`. Those documents distinguish valid treatment evidence from diagnostics, compatibility checks, and transport failures.

The current ARA contains aggregate metrics, selected machine summaries, hashes, and evidence pointers. Raw prompts, full traces, credentials, and some immutable run reports remain outside Git in `PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME`. Therefore this directory is reviewable but is not yet a self-contained public reproduction archive.

| ID | Item | Role | Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| E01 | Harvey LAB repository/architecture | task and official harness substrate | https://github.com/harveyai/harvey-labs |
| E02 | Harvey LAB v1.0 tutorial | execution/model adapter reference | https://github.com/harveyai/harvey-labs/blob/v1.0/docs/tutorial.md |
| E03 | Google agent-system architecture study | rationale for fixed centralized architecture | https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.08296 |
| E04 | ARA paper/repository | research-artifact management structure | https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24658 |
| E05 | Proofpress protocol/docs in this repository | portable artifact-lineage mechanism | `../../README.md` and `../../docs/` |

Qualified model-run evidence names the frozen configuration, source hashes, requested and resolved model, provider, fallback state, token and latency telemetry, and the applicable scorer or verification record. Missing required telemetry is a qualification failure, not a zero-cost observation. ARA indexes research meaning and evidence pointers; Proofpress supplies admitted lineage and independent verification, never a benchmark agent's implicit memory or a raw session transcript.
